observations.publisher: Reuters (reporting statements by US Transportation Secretary and DHS)
observations.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said US airspace reopened at 20:15 EST November 13 (01:15 UTC November 14) after an exceptional nationwide ground stop. He attributed the disruption to overloaded routers and switches producing inconsistent data and said the immediate fault was fixed. Departures were to resume gradually, with widespread cancellations continuing. DHS reported no evidence so far of a cyberattack; root cause investigation remains incomplete. This is a confirmed operational restoration of a previously reported disruption, not proof of hostile activity.
observations.title: FAA lifts nationwide departure ground stop after network instability
